item.title: ABC News: Cross River Rail worker tells inquiry he 'saw red' in brawl with CFMEU members
item.description: A commission of inquiry into the Queensland branch of the CFMEU has heard a group of workers were attacked by union members at a Cross River Rail site in Dutton Park.

item.title: ABC News: ACT police investigate after man found dead during welfare check
item.description: Police are investigating the suspicious death of a 70-year-old man in Canberra's north after officers discovered his body at a Watson home yesterday during a welfare check.

item.title: ABC News: WA teenager Austin Appelbee awarded bravery medal for swim rescue
item.description: Perth schoolboy Austin Appelbee is recognised for his heroic efforts in swimming 4 kilometres through rough ocean waters to save his family.

item.title: ABC News: Body found in livestock trough on northern NSW farm
item.description: Police launch an investigation after the discovery of a body submerged in a tank used to treat livestock for ticks on a NSW property.

item.title: ABC News: Woman stabbed during random Melbourne tram attack
item.description: The 51-year-old was stabbed in the neck while travelling on a tram passing through South Melbourne.

item.title: ABC News: AI drones on the cards for WA as shark-tagging program expanded
item.description: Western Australia's shark-tagging program will be expanded and the use of AI-powered drones investigated as part of a suite of measures aimed at keeping beachgoers safe.

item.title: ABC News: Former Melbourne girls' school teacher charged with sexual assault
item.description: Methodist Ladies' College confirmed in a letter to parents on Monday that former staff member Kam Kenny-Jones had been charged by Victoria Police with the sexual assault of a child.

item.title: ABC News: Women's stars call on Cricket Australia to fix scheduling
item.description: Concerns are growing about the lack of women's cricket in school-friendly slots over summer, amid warnings the schedule will hurt the game's growth among girls.

item.title: ABC News: Comedian Judith Lucy announces cancer diagnosis
item.description: The comedian and actress made the announcement in a lighthearted video posted to social media.

item.title: ABC News: Woman cleared of murdering adult children convicted of fraud offence
item.description: The judge told the court her fraud offending was serious and involved "sustained dishonesty".

item.title: ABC News: Coalition promises deep cuts in migration fight with One Nation, Labor
item.description: The Coalition would cut net overseas migration to 100,000 for two years under a sweeping overhaul targeting graduate and bridging visas.

item.title: ABC News: Influencers, firms cut ties with former Bachelor Sam Wood after DV charges
item.description: Businesses and colleagues are cutting ties with reality TV star and businessman Sam Wood as he faces domestic violence allegations.

item.title: ABC News: Former ACT Greens leader Shane Rattenbury is Lifeline Canberra's CEO
item.description: Former ACT Greens leader Shane Rattenbury has been appointed as the new chief executive officer of Lifeline Canberra, as the organisation reports a 61 per cent increase in calls for help in the 2025-26 financial year.

item.title: ABC News: Coalition wants Victoria to 'lead the world' in youth mental health care
item.description: The state opposition has promised to expand the number of patient transit lounges at Victorian hospitals and invest in youth mental health if it wins next month's election.
